panel.title: Plugin Guard
panel.subtitle: Crash recovery and observability
panel.unavailableHint: The host does not expose the guard routes (no webServer in this runtime).
panel.archiveConfirm: Archive the current artifacts and restart from the latest facts?
panel.conflictNotice: State changed, so the last action was not executed. The view now shows the latest facts — decide again from them.
panel.emptyHint: The guard has not recorded any startup facts yet.
panel.pollingPaused: polling paused (the view is frozen at the pause moment)

markov.title: Transition matrix
markov.hint: Where each stage goes next (Markov chain)
markov.empty: No transitions recorded yet — the matrix is not determinable

dataflow.title: Data flow
dataflow.hint: From host facts to panel pixels (white box)
dataflow.journalDetail: Facts appended line-by-line by the host (synchronous IO on the crash path — survives the crash)
dataflow.eventsDetail: Journal tail (up to 40 entries) enters the snapshot
dataflow.flowDetail: Each event maps to stage/action/flow direction (kind→semantic table; unknown kinds are quoted verbatim)
dataflow.renderDetail: Every card renders from the same snapshot (one timestamp — never 'state at A, metrics at B')

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.hint: Host & plugin version facts + feedback entry
diagnostics.issuesHint: Wrong plugin disabled / recovery misbehaving? Open an issue with the partition key + time + plugin name

backupPolicy.hint: Adjust policy in dsh Settings → Plugins → dsh-recency-guard (versionedBackups / backupRetain / backupRoot).

decisionEvidence.empty: No suspect list yet (no crash-recovery decision has been made)
decisionEvidence.legacy: This decision predates factor recording — showing no fake zero values
decisionEvidence.hint: The three weighted factors sum to the risk score; bar length = that factor's contribution (0-1)
decisionEvidence.head: Primary suspect
decisionEvidence.riskHint: Weighted sum of three factors in [0,1]; not a crash probability
decisionEvidence.streakHint: Consecutive rounds as the primary suspect (including this round)
decisionEvidence.changeCountHint: Install/update events for this plugin in the journal
decisionEvidence.sourceHint: Evidence source: journal = install fact; mtime = bootstrap value

capabilities.exposedMismatch: the graph's exposure marks disagree with the snapshot count (the graph counts node weight)
capabilities.none: The graph has no capability node
capabilities.graphMissing: Graph data is not ready: the produce/consume links live in the graph only, and nothing is guessed here

graph.title: Capability production and consumption
graph.hint: ctrl/⌘ + wheel zoom · drag to pan · drag a node to nudge it · click to highlight · double-click to centre · Esc to exit
graph.unavailable: Graph data unavailable (the host returned no graph).
graph.onlyConnectedHint: Keep only the subgraph reachable from the selected node (select a node first)
graph.minimapHint: the box is what you can see right now; click or drag it to move the main view
graph.filteredEmpty: The current filters hid every node.

partitions.title: Project partitions
partitions.hint: Each workspace keeps its own ledger; none pollutes another.
partitions.mismatch: The host data surface cannot query by partition: {requested}… was requested but the current partition {actual}… came back.
partitions.writeNote: The data surface (snapshot / graph / archives) is always served by the host for its current workspace; inspecting another partition never changes what the host writes.

archives.explain: Archiving = move away + keep the manifest (read before moving); after a reset no old conclusion is inherited and the cycle restarts from the latest facts.
archives.reasonPlaceholder: Why archive this (it is kept in the manifest)

cooccurrence.hint: Checks whether official-experimental activity predicts non-official suspects — verification only, no weighting

bayes.hint: A second reading alongside "Suspect ranking" (research doc 07 2.3: parallel reading, never replaces the default)
